SELECT SUM (num) FROM( SELECT COUNT(TRADE_ID) num FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL WHERE FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND (IS_CANCEL='N' or IS_CANCEL IS NULL) UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(TRADE_ID) num FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL WHERE FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId})
